title: Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Offset Terms
content:
Within Commercial Natural Gas Supply, the carbon offset terms of a plan state what share of the site's usage has its combustion emissions matched with retired carbon offsets, under which registry standard, at what quantity per therm billed, and whether the business receives an annual offset retirement statement.

| Plan | Share of usage offset (percent) | Offset registry standard | Metric tons CO2e offset per therm billed | Annual offset retirement statement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 0 | None | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | 0 | None | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | 0 | None | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | 0 | None | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | 0 | None | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | 100 | Verra Verified Carbon Standard | 0.0053 | Yes |

## Reading the terms

Only the Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 plan carries offsets. On that plan the combustion emissions of 100 percent of the usage are matched with retired offsets under the Verra Verified Carbon Standard, at 0.0053 metric tons of CO2e for each therm billed, and the business receives an annual offset retirement statement. The other five plans carry no offsets, show no registry standard and provide no statement.

## Illustration (hypothetical usage)

A site on the Carbon Neutral 24 plan billed 10,000 therms over a year has 53 metric tons of CO2e offset for that year: 10,000 therms multiplied by 0.0053. The same usage on any other plan has no offset.
